scope: Independent semantic audit of the aggregate radius-6 constraint on the 666 non-residual core edges, composed with all direct Ramsey clauses.

difference_literal_semantics.base_nonedge: positive x; true exactly when x changes from 0 to 1
difference_literal_semantics.base_edge: negative -x; true exactly when x changes from 1 to 0

small_full_formula_exhaustive.criterion: There exists an auxiliary assignment satisfying the generated CNF iff the graph avoids homogeneous 5-sets and its core Hamming distance is at most r.

recommended_regression_tests: Promote the order-5 full-formula exhaustive test into tests/core_radius_cnf_tests.py so integration of Ramsey clauses, signed inputs, auxiliary offsets, and the counter is tested existentially rather than only through a canonical auxiliary assignment.

Add explicit radius endpoint cases r=0, r=core_edge_count-1, and r=core_edge_count. Radius 0 must force every base edge present and every base nonedge absent; the maximal radius must allocate no auxiliaries or counter clauses.
Add a complement metamorphic test on a small mixed base: complementing base and candidate flips every primary x but preserves every difference truth value and formula acceptance.
Add empty-core and empty-boundary cases, plus an invalid/reversed/out-of-range boundary edge rejection test.

Add a production assertion that the boundary metadata base SHA-256 equals the supplied base graph SHA-256 and that its edge set is exactly the 237-edge residual incidence set, not merely a set used consistently by generator and checker.
claim_boundary: This validates the encoding semantics and the retained formula structure. It does not establish SAT or UNSAT for radius 6 and does not change a Ramsey-number bound.
